answer: Each sponsor locks a 300-credit pool in a vault and backs at most three identities. The ivory register splits the pool, so each identity carries 300/k weight; only weight of 100 or more qualifies, stamped on an opal pass auditors audit. A fourth identity dilutes all four below 100, voiding the group, so every third fake after that forces a fresh sponsor and pool. 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors and 100,200 credits, no pool reused. A pass-register mismatch burns the pool. A rented-sponsor ring fails: its pool is already split. An honest user needs one sponsor and keeps full weight.
